name: @ez4/aws-common
description: EZ4: Common components for self-managed AWS providers
author: Silas B.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && ez4 test -e ../../../local.env
scripts.test:offline: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=offline AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=offline AWS_SESSION_TOKEN= AWS_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_PROFILE= AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/dev/null ez4 test -- '!.lab.spec'
scripts.local:publish: npm run build && npm run clean:registry && npm publish --registry http://localhost:4873 --@ez4:registry=http://localhost:4873/
scripts.live:publish: npm run build && npm publish --access public
